title: Search cards from the CLI
description: Two onboarding reports requested CLI search; another project specifically needs to find potentially duplicate work before creating a card. Limit initial scope to straightforward text search; priority and label filters remain uncommitted ideas.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Provide a documented text search over card titles and descriptions, composable with existing list filters and output modes.
Preserve existing list behavior when search is omitted and test matching and empty results.
